name: Related Skills
headline: Codex Supergraph: On-Chain Data GraphQL API
short_description: Codex Supergraph integrates multiple data sources into a unified API. It is ideal for developers seeking to streamline their data interactions.
author: codex-data

sections.overview:
Codex Supergraph is a GraphQL API integration skill that enables AI agents to access real-time and historical blockchain data from the Codex on-chain data platform. The skill supports querying token prices, pair metadata, OHLCV bars, maker events, holder information, and establishing live WebSocket subscriptions for streaming data. Setup requires an API key from codex.io and follows the Agent Skills specification for seamless integration into Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI-powered applications. Developers building data-driven applications benefit from unified access to on-chain information without managing multiple data source connections.
Aggregate data from multiple APIs in a single query.
Simplify data fetching for application developers.
Improve performance by reducing the number of requests needed.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/codex-data/skills --skill codex-supergraph`
`git clone https://github.com/codex-data/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a unified API schema for [COMPANY]'s [INDUSTRY] data sources using Codex Supergraph. Merge [DATA_SOURCE_1], [DATA_SOURCE_2], and [DATA_SOURCE_3] into a single, normalized API. Include authentication, rate limits, and error handling. Provide the schema in GraphQL format.
```
